div.font: Topology (2×2 mesh shown) wired by scripts in configs/topologies/*.py via makeExtInLink / makeExtOutLink / makeInternalLink. Each router owns 4 mesh ports + 1 "Local" port for its NI. VNETs (e.g. CHI: REQ=0, SNP=1, RSP=2, DAT=3) are deadlock-isolated: each has its own VC pool per port.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 965px; margin-left: 18px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;

display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 989px; margin-left: 18px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;
div.font:
1. Protocol controller enqueues MsgPtr on MessageBuffer (outbound vnet).
2. NI::wakeup() dequeues; flitisizeMessage() chops msg into HEAD/BODY/TAIL flits sized m_ni_flit_size; calculateVC(vnet) picks a VC.
3. Flits pushed into niOutVcs[vc]; scheduleOutputLink() moves one flit/cycle to OutputPort.outFlitQueue → NetworkLink.
4. NetworkLink::wakeup() delays flit by m_latency cycles, then schedules Router::wakeup() at the next hop.
5. Router::wakeup() → InputUnit::wakeup(): for HEAD, RoutingUnit::outportCompute() writes outport into VirtualChannel.
6. Flit buffered for (m_latency−1) cycles; then SwitchAllocator::wakeup() runs SA-I (inport RR) and SA-II (outport RR); allocates outvc for HEAD.
7. Winning flit passes through CrossbarSwitch into OutputUnit.outBuffer; decrement_credit; InputUnit sends Credit to upstream on CreditLink.
8. GarnetIntLink delivers flit to next router's InputUnit; on final hop an ExtLink drops it into the destination NI.InputPort.
9. At destination NI::wakeup(): accumulate flits by packet_id; on TAIL, enqueue original MsgPtr into outNode_ptr[vnet] → protocol controller.
